pk: Banatyan tu niscite jijnasayogatsandigDatvena brahnEva visaya
ck: panatyan tu niscite cicnasayokatsantiktatvena prahnEva visaya

ck: kecitu cicnasasapto rutya laksanaya va vicaran narpayati

ck: panatyan tu na cicnasa nana vicara

ck: atra parErvetanta prahnani na prananan sitavastupotane .

ck: ata eva vacyatvasya srutatvatityartasyeksatisutra eva vivaksitatvat

ck: na ca sripatitvatikan linkan niravakasaniti vacyan

ck: yacoktan parErcakarite hi civasya sarirapahyakasa stanan

ck: astu visno karanatvan na tu sarvasananvaya

ck: kin ca prayoko cnapaka sakterninitan tu niyanakan

ck: purvatra kevalayuktayavirota ukta atra tu trtayuktayavirota ucyate

ck: yatuktanupapyan isvara sasye parcanya iva sataranakaranan
